what: Source-bound capture receipt for the 24 'after' and 8 'before' pictures in after/ and before/ (AGEND-214, review of upstream PR #3709 item 7).

pins.head: 6aaf195c0936d90b88b38b0e684c996c1a181a6a
pins.base: c1cfcfe03c6a54f989b4ae8467ceadf22f57fe46 (upstream release/2.3.5-alpha tip, one commit after v2.4.0-alpha.1)
pins.previousEvidenceCommit: 89d05fdd98e2f025fb1db525e70b1229cd46be1a captured PR2 131d263aa (PR1 ancestor caf059b3f); it did NOT contain b0feba52f — superseded by this set, kept as it is

meaning of before: The REAL base c1cfcfe03 product (no activity block code, no /ui/steps route at all — the page never asks, stepsRequests is empty). The earlier set's 'before' was the candidate UI with /ui/steps answered 404; this one is the actual before.

harness.how: The product's own FleetManager serves the page; an admin signs in with a real dashboard login code. GET /ui/steps is NOT stubbed: it runs the real route (admission, re-check after the read), the real LogService and parser, and the server-side cut, reading a scratch copy of the committed redacted Claude Code transcript tests/fixtures/chat-activity-3648/claude-web-chat.jsonl. The instance's statusline.json points at that copy; its web-chat ledger is the fixture's ledger.
whatIsChanged: every record's timestamp (and each ledger row's ts) is shifted by one constant so the running turn is 'now'

the running scenes cut the transcript just before turn 2's reply result: the reply call is in; its result, the closing '.' and turn_end are not; the ledger has the first three rows (turn 2's reply row has not arrived)
the header's status word 'Stopped' is replaced by 'Working' (the instance is not running), as the #3639 mockups did
emoji in message text render as a missing-glyph box: this machine has no emoji font (not the product)

browser.chrome: Google Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.4 (playwright chromium-1248), headless, --no-sandbox
browser.matrix: desktop/phone x light/dark x en/zh-TW = 8 sets; after: 3 states each (1 finished turn shut + running turn shut; running opened at standard; opened at verbose), before: 1

servedBytes.note: Every /ui/js/*.js and /assets/*.js|css response body of every capture was hashed in the browser and compared with the file at the pinned commit.
